_comment: Tool-facing hardware/address declaration for the Konami Pooyan board (GX320).
pooyan_state::pooyan(machine_config) and ROM_START(pooyan). Same role as the dkong,
thepit and timeplt files: the single source of truth the shared Python tools read
via --hardware, so tools/ stays game-agnostic. Numbers are decimal (JSON has no 0x);
'_hex'/'_note' fields are annotations the loader ignores.
Forked from boards/timeplt/hardware.json; the deltas (32KB ROM, 0x8000-block RAM map,
60.606061Hz/50688, 0xA1xx I/O) all come straight from pooyan.cpp.
★ dsw0.expected (0xFF) and controlByte (0xAF) MEASURED from a MAME golden config probe
(2026-08-19). landmarks[] still empty -- boot-init-done / first-vblank cycles not yet
extracted from the golden; non-blocking (scope.py coverage report only).

screen._note: pooyan.cpp:440 set_raw(18.432/3, 384, 0,256, 264, 16,240) -> visible H 0..255 (256), V 16..239 (224). ROT90 (pooyan.cpp:544), same portrait orientation as timeplt.

_refresh_note: 6.144MHz/(384*264) ~= 60.606061 -- the DKONG/THEPIT figure. NOT timeplt's exact 60. pooyan.cpp:440 set_raw pixel clock 18.432/3.
_cpu_note: pooyan.cpp:424 Z80 at 18.432_MHz_XTAL / 3 / 2 = 3.072MHz. Identical derivation to Time Pilot.
_cycles_note: 3072000 / 60.606061 = 50688 = htotal*vtotal/... i.e. cpu runs 50688 cycles per 384*264 raster. Differs from timeplt's 51200 because the refresh differs.

stateRegions.name: color
stateRegions._hex: 0x8000-0x83FF colour RAM (tile ATTRIBUTES; colorram_w marks tilemap dirty) -- pooyan.cpp:295

stateRegions.name: sprite0
stateRegions._hex: 0x9000-0x90FF spriteram[0] (mirror MASK 0x0B00 -- don't-care bits, not an offset) -- pooyan.cpp:298

writeRanges.name: watchdog
writeRanges._hex: 0xA000 watchdog reset (READ at same address returns DSW1) -- pooyan.cpp:305

writeRanges.name: sound_data
writeRanges._hex: 0xA100 timeplt_audio sound_data_w to the audio Z80 -- pooyan.cpp:306

writeRanges.name: mainlatch
writeRanges._hex: 0xA180-0xA187 LS259 B2, write_d0, ONE address per bit -> bit = (addr-0xA180)&7. b0=NMI enable, b1=audio sh_irqtrigger, b2=audio mute, b3=coin0, b4=coin1, b5=payout(nop), b7=flip_screen(INVERTED). NO video-enable bit. -- pooyan.cpp:307,427-434

dsw0._expected_note: 0xFF -- MEASURED from a MAME golden config probe (default KONAMI_COINAGE reads all-high); matches io.js / manifest idle.

_dsw1_note: 0xA000 reads DSW1 (pooyan.cpp:300) = 0x7B: Lives 3 (0x03) | Upright (0x00) | Bonus 50K (0x08) | Diff 1-Easy (0x70) | Demo On (0x00), from the driver dip defaults. DSW1 is not config-probe-checked, only DSW0.
_controlByte_note: 0xAF = ROM[0x0000], the reset 'xor a' opcode. Config-probe that the program ROM loaded; a MAME golden run read 0xAF with no poison.

z80Reset._hex: MAME Z80 reset: AF=0x0040 (Z flag set), IX=IY=0xFFFF, rest 0 -- same for every MAME Z80

interrupt._note: pooyan.cpp:264-276 vblank_irq() asserts INPUT_LINE_NMI only while mainlatch bit-0 (irq_enable) is set; clearing that bit clears the line. Same interrupt model as dkong/timeplt.

_landmarks_todo: ★ EMPTY -- boot-init-done / first-vblank-NMI cycles not yet extracted. A golden now captures cleanly (romset present); these feed scope.py's coverage report only, so it is non-blocking. Extract once a translated boot exists to bracket.
